commands: $p = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($s.PhysicalPath); "PATH=$p exists=$(Test-Path $p)"; if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 60 | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($p.Length) + ' (' + $_.Length + 'b)' } }

foreach ($f in 'anonymousAuthentication','windowsAuthentication','basicAuthentication') { try { $v=(Get-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $pp -Filter "system.webServer/security/authentication/$f" -Name enabled -ErrorAction Stop).Value; "$f=$v" } catch { "$f=err" } }

try { $da=(Get-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $pp -Filter 'system.webServer/security/ipSecurity' -Name allowUnlisted -ErrorAction Stop).Value; "ipSecurity allowUnlisted=$da"; (Get-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $pp -Filter 'system.webServer/security/ipSecurity' -Name '.').Collection | ForEach-Object { "  allow=$($_.allowed) $($_.ipAddress)/$($_.subnetMask)" } } catch { 'no ipSecurity' }

if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')) $($_.Name)" } }
